business_summary: Tianjin Ruixin Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sales of industrial precision aluminum alloy parts and components in China and internationally. It offers systematic and personalized aluminum alloy products and services. The company's products include heat transfer parts, 5G base station, energy storage box, low voltage inverter, battery tray, motor casing, power and digital controller, and solar inverter; new energy vehicle parts; and clean energy components. It also provides transportation lightweighting system, such as automotive protective parts, structural components, and sunroof parts, as well as rail controls; and industrial automation system comprising industrial rail, electric, and structural parts, and medical device parts. In addition, the company offers CNC machine tools; extruders; friction stir welding machine; coordinate measuring center; deep machining automatic production line; wire cutting machine; automatic machine center; automatic production line; automatic metallographic specimen setting machine; metallographic specimen running machine; metallographic microscope; tensile test; three-point bending tool; three-coordinate testing; salt spray test; universal tensile machine; imaging instrument; and direct reading spectrometer. It serves customers in power electronics and communication equipment radiators and fields; automobile lightweight and new energy automobile parts; automation technology; and medical devices sectors. Tianjin Ruixin Technology Co.,Ltd was formerly known as Tianjin Ruixinchang Light Alloy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tianjin Ruixin Technology Co.,Ltd in November 2017. Tianjin Ruixin Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 2004 and is based in Tianjin, China.
